info.title: Bloxwap Chart SDK — Documentation Site API
info.summary: Machine-readable endpoints published by the @bloxwap/chart documentation site.
info.description: The Bloxwap Chart SDK (`@bloxwap/chart`) is a client-side TypeScript library for interactive financial charts on HTML canvas. It has no hosted HTTP API: charts are rendered by JavaScript running in your own page, worker, or test. This specification documents every machine-readable HTTP resource the documentation site itself publishes — the llms.txt agent index, the sitemap, the full-text search index, and this specification — so agents can discover and consume them automatically. The library's JavaScript API (createChart, indicators, drawings, the React component) is documented at https://bloxwap.github.io/chart/docs/api/chart/ and indexed in https://bloxwap.github.io/chart/llms.txt.

Markdown error body for missing pages: explains the error and links to the documentation, llms.txt, sitemap, and developer portal. Fetch this after receiving a 404 HTML response to get an agent-readable explanation.

internalDocumentIDStore.description: Mapping of internal document IDs to page URLs.

NotFound.description: No resource exists at this path. Because the site is statically hosted, the error body is an HTML page (Content-Type: text/html) whose visible text explains the error and links to the documentation, llms.txt, and sitemap; the same explanation in Markdown is available at /404.md (linked from the error page with rel="alternate").
